name: 02-coding-agent
query: I need a prompt for Claude Code. It should fix the session timeout bug in our Express API — sessions expire after 5 minutes instead of 24 hours. The logic lives in src/middleware/session.js.
expected_behavior: Reads references/tools-agentic.md and does not read tools-visual.md
The turn reads at most two references/tools-*.md files in total
Output contains exactly one fenced prompt block
The generated prompt names the path src/middleware/session.js
The generated prompt contains a scope lock section listing what may be touched and what must be left unchanged
The generated prompt contains an action boundaries section naming at least one action the agent must ask about before performing
The generated prompt contains a section whose heading includes the glossary term 'Completion criteria'

That section lists at least 2 items, and each item names one of: a file path that must exist, a command or test that must pass, a named value that must equal a stated value, or an endpoint that must return a stated response
The generated prompt instructs the agent to report progress evidence grounded in tool results or changed files
The response appends the agentic output notice beginning 'This prompt is for an agentic tool with real system access'
The generated prompt does not instruct the model to reveal its chain of thought or private reasoning
The generated prompt does not set a thinking budget in tokens
